title: The schedule
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Monday. The Greyhound schedule from 1999, still on the corkboard. The departure circled in pencil. Wood un-pins it, reads it, and pins it back with the circle facing the wall.

panels.composition: The bedroom. The corkboard. WOOD unpinning a folded bus schedule, yellowing already. BARNABY on the bed.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a young man unpinning a folded yellowing bus schedule from a corkboard in a small bedroom, a small dog on the bed
image.notes: The schedule from dw_1999-04-09. Departure circled: 4:10 (objects.md).

panels.composition: The schedule open. A column of times. One circled in pencil, 1999: 4:10. Saturday.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, close-up of a bus schedule with a column of times and one time circled in pencil

panels.composition: Wood looking at the circle. A long time. The dog watching him look.

panels.composition: The schedule pinned back. Folded so the circle faces the cork. The blank side out.
